title: Plants Around Us
description: Grade 1 Science: meet the plants around us! Parts of a plant, what plants need, how a seed grows, and a fun grow-a-bean experiment — with interactive games.

topics.title: What is a Plant?
topics.concept:
Plants are living things. Just like you, they are born, they grow bigger, and they need food and water to stay alive.

Plants are everywhere! You can find them in:

  • 🏡 Gardens and pots at home
  • 🌳 Parks and along the road
  • 🌾 Big farms and green forests

Some plants are tiny like grass. Some are huge like a mango tree. But every plant is alive!

recap: A plant is a living thing — it grows and needs water.
Plants are found all around us — at home, in parks, on farms.
Plants can be very small (grass) or very big (a tree).

wonder.text: Look out of your window. How many green living things can you spot?

qa.q: Is a plant alive like me?
qa.a: Yes! A plant grows, drinks water and makes baby plants from seeds — so it is a living thing, just like you.
No. Plants stay in one place because their roots hold them in the soil. But they CAN slowly turn their leaves towards the sunlight!

topics.title: Parts of a Plant
topics.concept:
Most plants have four main parts. Each one helps the plant in a special way:

  • 🌿 Roots — hold the plant in the soil and drink water.
  • 🌱 Stem — stands tall and carries water up to the leaves.
  • 🍃 Leaves — make food for the plant using sunlight.
  • 🌸 Flower — makes seeds so new plants can grow.

recap: Roots hold the plant and drink water.
Stem holds the plant up and carries water.

wonder.text: A plant has special parts, and each part has its own job. Can you guess what the roots do?

qa.q: Why can't I see the roots of a tree?
qa.a: Roots usually grow under the ground, hidden in the soil. They spread out to hold the big tree steady and to drink lots of water.

qa.q: Which part makes the plant's food?
qa.a: The green leaves! They catch sunlight and use it to make food for the whole plant. Clever leaves!

topics.title: What Plants Need to Grow
topics.concept:
Plants are living, so they need a few things to grow healthy and strong:

  • ☀️ Sunlight — to make their food.
  • 💧 Water — to drink every day.
  • 🌬️ Air — plants breathe air too!
  • 🟫 Soil — to hold the roots and give them food bits.

If a plant does not get sunlight and water, it becomes weak, turns yellow, and may even die. That is why we water the plants in our home and keep them near a window.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 360 155" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="360" height="155" fill="#eefff2"/><text x="45" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">☀️</text><text x="45" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Sun</text><text x="135" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">💧</text><text x="135" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Water</text><text x="225" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🌬️</text><text x="225" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Air</text><text x="315" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🟫</text><text x="315" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Soil</text><text x="180" y="142" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">What plants need</text></svg>
recap: Plants need sunlight, water, air and soil.
Leaves use sunlight to make the plant's food.
Without sunlight and water, a plant turns weak and yellow.

wonder.text: What do you think would happen to a little plant kept inside a dark cupboard for a week?

qa.q: Do plants need food like we do?
qa.a: Plants are special — they MAKE their own food in their leaves using sunlight, water and air. We cannot do that. That is their superpower!

qa.q: Can a plant get too much water?
qa.a: Yes! Too much water is not good either — the roots can rot. Plants like the right amount, not too little and not too much.

topics.title: Plants Give Us Food
topics.concept:
Plants are very kind — they give us lots of food to eat!

  • 🍎 Fruits — apple, mango, banana
  • 🥕 Vegetables — carrot, potato, spinach
  • 🌾 Grains — rice, wheat (for roti and bread)
  • 🫘 Pulses — dal, beans, chana

We even eat different parts of plants! A carrot is a root, spinach is a leaf, and an apple grows from a flower.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 155" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="155" fill="#fff7ea"/><text x="55" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🍎</text><text x="55" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Fruit</text><text x="165" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🥕</text><text x="165" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Veg</text><text x="275" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🌾</text><text x="275" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Grain</text><text x="165" y="142" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Plants give us food</text></svg>
recap: Plants give us fruits, vegetables, grains and pulses.
We eat different parts: carrot = root, spinach = leaf.
Rice and wheat are foods that grow on plants.

wonder.text: Look at your lunch plate. How much of it began as a plant?

qa.q: Is rice really from a plant?
qa.a: Yes! Rice grows on a grass-like plant in flooded fields. Wheat for your roti and bread grows on a plant too.

qa.q: Which part of the plant is a potato?
qa.a: A potato grows under the ground — it is a special swollen stem that stores food for the plant. We get to eat that stored food!

topics.title: From Seed to Plant
topics.concept:
Every big plant once started as a small seed. With soil, water and sunlight, the seed slowly wakes up and grows:

  • 🌰 First, a seed is planted in the soil.
  • 🌱 A tiny sprout pushes out, with roots going down.
  • 🪴 It grows into a young plant with leaves.
  • 🌷 At last it becomes a grown plant with flowers and new seeds.

Then the new seeds can grow into more plants. This happens again and again — it is the plant's life cycle!

recap: Every plant starts as a tiny seed.
Order of growing: seed → sprout → young plant → grown plant.
A grown plant makes new seeds, and the cycle starts again.

wonder.text: How does a tiny seed, smaller than your fingernail, become a tall plant?

qa.q: How long does a seed take to sprout?
qa.a: It depends on the plant! A bean seed can sprout in just 3 to 5 days, but a tree can take many weeks. Patience helps.
Water and warmth! When a seed gets water and a cosy warm spot, it wakes up and begins to grow its first little root.

questions.q: Which of these is a living thing?
questions.explanation: A plant grows and needs water, so it is living.

questions.q: Which plant part drinks water from the soil?
questions.explanation: Roots are under the soil and drink water for the plant.

questions.q: Which part of the plant makes the plant's food?
questions.explanation: Green leaves use sunlight to make food.

questions.q: What does a plant NOT need to grow?
questions.explanation: Plants need sunlight, water and air — not candy!

questions.q: A plant grows from a tiny…
questions.explanation: Every plant starts life as a small seed.

questions.q: Which part of the plant makes new seeds?
questions.explanation: The flower makes seeds, which grow into new plants.

questions.q: A carrot is which part of a plant?
questions.explanation: A carrot is a root that stores food under the ground.

questions.q: Put in order: which comes FIRST in a plant's life?
questions.explanation: The order is seed → sprout → young plant → grown plant with flowers.

questions.q: A plant kept in a dark cupboard for many days will most likely…
questions.explanation: Without sunlight, leaves cannot make food, so the plant turns weak and yellow.

questions.q: Rice and wheat for our food grow on…
questions.explanation: Rice and wheat are grains that grow on plants.

questions.q: Which job belongs to the STEM?
options: Hold the plant up and carry water
questions.explanation: The stem holds the plant up and carries water from the roots to the leaves.
